why: What GitHub's Actions settings, environments, secrets and variables for this repository are meant to be. scripts/deploy/Check-GitHubSettings.ps1 reads GitHub and names every difference (#3534); a change to a setting is a pull request to this file and the change on GitHub together. docs/RUNNER-ISOLATION.md in the ops repo, section 1, says why each is what it is; Developer-Guide.md section P and docs/OWNERSHIP.md in the ops repo say what each secret is. Names only, never a value. Since #4013 the box's workflows and their secrets are in the ops repository: CLOUDFLARE_TURNSTILE_TOKEN, the notices environment and the desk's DESK_KEY_B64 went there at the flip, and desk keeps NEXUS_API_KEY for nexus-run.yml, which runs here on GitHub's runner.
